colors.source_note: source/html/tokens.json's top-level colors.primary/secondary (#FFFFFF / #0065B3) are a frequency-heuristic misread of the CSS (logged upstream as issue #53) -- #FFFFFF is just the page background, not the brand primary. The values above are read directly from each CSS file's :root block, byte-identical across all 9 stylesheets, and match the developer-confirmed brand palette (primary #0065B3, sky #00B3F0, navy #002842, text #090909, light sky #77DCFF).

tokens.canvas_notes: No section-level background/theme class system exists (no s-paper/s-cream equivalents). Every header/section/footer instead carries a single reset utility class '.rs' that (a) defines a fluid --u scaling unit sized against a 1440px desktop canvas, and (b) at <=1023px automatically swaps EVERY '.rs' element's background to #FCFEFF (--color-mobile-bg) EXCEPT '.pb' (home's procedure-band section) and '.site-foot' (footer), which keep their own explicit backgrounds. This mobile background swap is pure CSS (:not() selectors), not a class toggled in markup -- the theme/CSS build must replicate the same selector exception list, not a flat background swap on all sections.
tokens.breakpoints_notes: Seeded from source/html/tokens.json. The two numbers are ONE boundary, not two separate breakpoints: desktop = @media (min-width: 1024px), mobile = @media (max-width: 1023px). No tablet-specific breakpoint exists anywhere across the 9 CSS files. QA/audit viewports should use two widths straddling this single boundary (matching the fluid canvas's own 1440px reference for desktop, e.g. 1440/390), not a hardcoded 3-viewport default.
tokens.notes: Spacing scale: --space-xs 8px / --space-sm 16px / --space-md 24px / --space-lg 48px / --space-xl 96px. Radii: --radius-sm 5px / --radius-md 10px / --radius-lg 20px. Focus ring: --interaction-focus-ring: 0 0 0 3px #00B3F059. Hover mix: --interaction-hover-mix: 85% (used with color-mix()). Utility classes '.d-only' / '.m-only' toggle desktop-only / mobile-only content at the 1024px boundary via CSS display:none (not JS) -- these must be preserved verbatim in the markup (not resolved/stripped at build time), since desktop and mobile variants sometimes carry different copy, not just different layout (e.g. hero-meta / value-columns line breaks). All 9 pages request the full Google Fonts family list regardless of which fonts that page's own CSS actually uses -- a copy/paste artifact worth trimming when the CSS is rebuilt.

assets.images_note: 118 images + 24 svgs inventoried in source/html/assets.json; 0 missing_assets (every referenced path resolves). Each page ships its OWN duplicated /assets/<page-slug>/ folder containing identical copies of shared files (e.g. logo-mizuho-header-srgb.png appears once per page folder, byte-identical) -- this is a static-export artifact, not 9 distinct logos. The ACF/theme build should canonicalize these into one media-library asset per unique file, not import 9 copies. Per-section image samples are recorded inline on each field below rather than duplicated in a flat top-level list.

It is linked on 8 of 9 pages; sales-hub-login.html does NOT load js/main.js, consistent with that page having no header/mobile-nav to toggle (see shared.header notes).
